A lean scrawny Mordor Orc swordsman, sickly olive skin, irregular flat rusty iron helmet, ragged brown leather and scraps of mail, serrated curved single-handed sword in his right hand. Asymmetrical crouched advancing stance with sword stretched low to his right and free left hand counterbalancing; narrow ribcage, knobbly knees and stooped neck. NOT a shield bearer.

A broad veteran Orc Captain with broken nose and one notched ear, mismatched iron breastplate and heavy left shoulder, faded dark red cloth and small red eye sash. Bellowing orders with sword lifted diagonally outward, free hand gesturing, feet firmly apart, thick forearms and old hunched back. No full mask, no identical marching stance.

A short sinewy Orc spearman with olive-gray skin, battered open conical helmet, leather jerkin and mail patch. Wide BRACED stance, both feet almost level horizontally, bent knees; BOTH hands grip a long rough wooden spear horizontally across the torso with its iron point aimed diagonally toward the viewer's left. No shield, NO step-forward pose. Narrow shoulders and long wiry forearms.

A lanky light-built Orc archer with pointed ears, dark hood pushed back, ragged ochre-brown jacket and quiver. Actively DRAWING a crooked wooden bow, left arm extended diagonally left, right hand at cheek with one nocked arrow, elbows clearly different. Feet planted in balanced wide stance, upper torso rotated slightly to aim but camera remains high/front. No helmet, no shield.

A very stocky Morannon Orc, squat powerful neck and barrel chest, red-brown pallid face beneath battered enclosed iron helmet, heavy overlapping blackened armour, oxblood tunic. A broad hooked axe raised above right shoulder, angular battered dark shield held forward on left, braced right foot behind left, leaning into a looming overhead strike. NOT long-limbed and not walking. GW LOTR Morannon armament, not Isengard white hand.

A smaller ragged Orc raider, gaunt pale yellow face with crooked grin, a shallow iron skullcap and greasy black hair, leather tunic, exposed thin forearms. Low twisted fighting stance, knees bent, curved sword held across chest ready to parry, empty left hand clawed beside hip. Distinct from advancing swordsman: BOTH feet spread laterally, no front stepping foot.

A squat heavy-bellied Mordor Orc shield fighter, broad yellow-gray face, battered iron helmet with off-center ridge, rusty iron/leather armour. Crouches behind a round plank shield held close to left shoulder, short chipped sword thrust low forward from right, one leg visibly sideways and both feet grounded. Shield and sword not in the trial's walking arrangement.

A taller but wiry hunched Orc spear guard, grim olive skin, patched leather with small iron plates and red sash. Holds a long spear vertically in right hand at his side, spearhead clear above; a TINY round buckler strapped to left forearm, left shoulder forward. Both legs straight in an alert sentry posture, feet nearly level, weight on back foot. No generic marching stance.

A heavy pot-bellied labourer Orc with thick short legs and powerful bare forearms, dull brown-gray skin, no helmet, ragged leather apron over mail. BOTH hands grasp a huge chipped two-handed AXE, broad axe head clearly visible, lifted diagonally across his right shoulder for a descending chop. Feet widely spread almost on same horizontal line, knees bent. NO shield, not a saw-blade sword.

A small skinny hunched Orc bowman with sallow skin and sparse dark hair, dirty brown hood, patchwork cloth, bent short bow. Moment of RELOADING, bow lowered in left hand, right hand reaching over shoulder into quiver for arrow. Deep crouch, feet side by side at different outward angles. Clearly not the drawing-bow pose of the other archer.

A squat broad Orc war drummer with exposed flabby belly and thick arms, open head with floppy leather cap, battered shoulder plate and dirty crimson wraps. Big round hide drum strapped IN FRONT of waist, one drumstick raised high and the other touching the drum head mid-beat. Both feet firmly planted, torso leaning slightly back from the heavy drum. No sword, no shield.

A very lean undersized Orc Tracker with bare sinewy legs, bald pinched sallow face, huge pointed ears, ragged minimal hide clothing. Kneels into low hunting crouch with one knee deeply bent and one foot sideways, head raised to watch, short wooden bow held low diagonally, quiver with few arrows. No heavy armour or generic helmet.

An overweight cruel Orc Taskmaster, thick waist and short neck, pale leathery face with evil grin, crude iron cap, mismatched armour and dirty red sash. Wide stance with chest leaning back, RIGHT arm lifted to flick a coiled whip over shoulder, left fist holding a short club down by hip. Whip loops legible within frame, no chain flail, no battle standard.

A muscular broad-shouldered Mordor Uruk-hai, dark umber skin, heavy jaw with short dark hair, no white-hand insignia. Five-head stocky body distinct from ordinary orc. Rough black iron mail and rectangular overlapping plates, jagged short heavy sword held shoulder high, SMALL angular shield angled away on left; one foot braced sideways as he snarls in a strong forward lean. No identical walking stance.

A heavily muscled Black Guard of Barad-dur, dark olive-brown uruk face visible beneath severe low iron helmet, thick arms and a broad chest. Blackened riveted plate over mail, muted red cloth, angular dark shield with small RED EYE (not glowing neon red armour). Standing square with shield across lower torso, brutal broad sword raised vertically at right shoulder in disciplined ready stance, both feet grounded. Stocky five-head proportions.

A barrel-chested thickset Morannon Orc with reddish ochre pallid skin and aggressive open face, battered angular helmet, heavy rusty black plate and oxblood cloth. Bent low in a shield BASH pose, angular dark iron shield pushed forward across chest, straight chopping sword drawn back beside right hip, rear leg extended sideways and knees bent. Entirely different pose from axe-bearing Morannon.

A wiry grizzled Orc veteran tracker with a scar over one eye, mottled gray-olive skin, ragged dark green hood and layered brown leather, pouches and short quiver. Low diagonal stalking stride, bent knees, short bow horizontally across body with arrow half-nocked; head turned slightly toward target, calm and predatory, lean shoulders and narrow waist. Not a tall heroic elf archer.

A pale green gaunt Minas Morgul Orc with crooked nose and thin arms, ragged olive-black hood, sparse rusted mail and torn dark green cloth. Hunched knife-raider stance, jagged curved sword low in right hand, left hand open for balance, one knee raised onto the ball of the foot and the other leg planted sideways. Asymmetric narrow body, no full smooth visor.

A very small spindly Morgul sneaking Orc, dirty gray-green skin and long pointed nose barely visible under a faded blue-gray hood. Ragged cloak kept close around narrow body, short knife in right hand, rope and pouches at belt. Deep crouch with BOTH feet close to ground and one hand extended low as if listening; visible face, no empty ringwraith hood.

A tall-for-an-orc but extremely thin Morgul Stalker, long wiry arms, pale gray skin, black hood and patchwork dark brown leather, simple dagger and hunting gear. Lunging to his right with bent leading knee, twin short knives held in opposing directions one at shoulder one at waist, cape clinging to narrow back. Face visible, no Nazgul face void. Five-head compact limbs.

A lean sinister human-sized Morgul Duellist, face covered by a tall narrow iron helmet with a ridge, black mail and dull iron plates, faded purple-black cape. BOTH hands wield two curved single-edged swords, one crossing chest to parry and one held out low. Fencer's wide planted stance, slim waist, five-head compact anatomy, no exaggerated long legs or neon trim. Game-original variant of Morgul elite.

An imposing broad HUMAN Black Numenorean warrior, long dark robes over black iron plate and chainmail, sinister fluted narrow crowned helmet with hidden face, deep dark red cloak. Five-head compact body, not an orc. Tower shield held vertical at left side, long straight sword held point-up close to right shoulder in a still menacing guard stance, feet almost level, upright disciplined chest. GW LOTR design.

A Black Numenorean HUMAN knight riding a black warhorse, full mount and rider. Rider in black plate and chainmail, narrow crowned helmet, black/deep-purple cloak, lance upright and narrow black shield. Horse diagonally only slightly left of frontal, head turned a little left, FOUR anatomically correct legs, one foreleg bent in deliberate walking step; subtle metal chamfron and dark saddle cloth. Rider's seated head-to-pelvis fits normal five-head human anatomy with visibly large head, believable thighs straddling saddle and feet in stirrups. Fixed high front 3/4 camera. NO floating rider or merged horse legs.

A Morgul Knight on a black armoured warhorse. Rider is slim HUMAN five-head proportions under black fluted plate and mail, black cloak with dull purple lining, narrow intimidating crowned helm. A long LANCE held diagonally outward to viewer left in couch-ready position, a small dark kite shield. Horse turns chest slightly right of frontal and STANDS BRACED with both front hooves planted apart, ears back, barding with subtle iron plates. Full four legs, correct straddling rider and stirrups, strong mount neck, no gigantic rider or tiny human head. Match high front 3/4 camera.

A tall broad but compact five-head Black Numenorean Marshal, imposing long closed iron crowned helmet, heavy black layered plate, dark red mantle and cloak, subtle dull bronze clasps. Upright command pose, left fist clenched in front of waist, straight long sword in right hand pointed diagonally down and outward; feet planted wide and almost level, stern chest. Dark iron surfaces with silver edge highlights; NO glowing red circuitry or fantasy spikes everywhere.

The Mouth of Sauron mounted on his black armoured horse, recognizable sealed tall black helm covering eyes and skull but exposing a horrible wide TOOTHED HUMAN MOUTH, long black robes and mail, straight sword. Rider leans forward to speak, sword lowered beside right thigh, left hand pulls reins. Horse head slightly lowered and turned left, iron chamfron, heavy black harness, one front hoof lifts while the other is planted. Full horse, four anatomically correct legs, rider natural saddle contact and normal human head scale. Fixed high frontal three-quarter camera, no scythe, no red fantasy armour.

Gothmog Lieutenant of Sauron ON FOOT, GW/movie likeness: very heavy bloated bald pale-pink and gray Orc with deformed swollen LEFT side of face and crippled small left arm. No skull mask, no helmet. Heavy blackened iron scale/plate over dark leather and dirty brown/red cloth, right hand holds broad curved sword pointed across lower body, useless left arm close to chest, broad shambling stance with one bent leg dragging slightly. Extreme thick belly and neck but compact five-head body, asymmetrical face clearly readable. Dark gritty LOTR, no generic scarlet knight.

Shagrat War Leader, a very broad muscular dark-skinned Uruk from Cirith Ungol, long greasy sparse BLACK hair, flattened fierce face with visible bared teeth, NO helmet. GW movie recognizable crude layered black/rust plate and chainmail, bare strong arms, huge rectangular wooden Shield of Cirith Ungol with iron boss in LEFT hand thrust forward, heavy straight cleaver-like SWORD raised across right shoulder. Powerful shield-rush stance with both knees flexed and one foot sideways. Massive shoulders narrow enough waist, five-head body. No generic orc helmet, no white hand.

Gorbag, a short wiry but tough Orc captain with pale dirty yellow-olive scarred face, thin greasy dark hair and large ears, NO helmet. Rough worn leather coat with ragged fur collar, patched chainmail, battered leggings. Crouched sideways-pivot stance, crooked broad sword raised in right hand at chest height, left hand gripping small round wooden shield close to flank. Lean weathered character, visibly smaller and narrower than Shagrat, compact five-head proportions. GW LOTR captain character, not generic masked black-armour warrior.

Kardush the Firecaller, grotesquely pot-bellied short Orc shaman, bald reddish ochre wrinkled skin, sagging belly, ragged leather and dirty dark red robes, bone/trophy ornaments. Heavy hunched stance with feet wide, crooked wooden staff topped by small contained orange flame in left hand, right hand held out palm up with one tiny ember. Scorched hands and crooked grin, no full helmet, no armour-clad knight, no massive special effects obscuring body. Five-head short thick body.

Grishnakh, a squat broad-backed hairy Orc with a long pale dirty-gray face, large ears and close-set eyes, greasy dark hair, black fur collar over ragged leather armour and dull red-brown cloth. Leaning forward with BOTH knees bent, short crooked sword held tight close to right hip, left hand reaching forward in a sneaky grasp. Thin lower legs under a thick torso, compact five-head anatomy. GW movie Orc likeness, no large horned helm or whip.

Guritz Orc lieutenant, tall for an orc but compact five-head proportions, very pale scarred face and yellow eyes; unmistakable battered IRON HELMET with a SMALL HUMAN SKULL IMPALED ON A SHORT SPIKE ON TOP. Black rough breastplate over rusty chainmail, dirty red tabard. Holds a long crude scythe-like two-handed battle blade diagonally across front with BOTH hands; feet planted wide and chest turning slightly left in ready sweeping stance. Skull above helmet is ornament and must not enlarge actual head. No shield or whip.

Guritz riding a dark gray WARG, unmistakable iron helmet topped by SMALL IMPALED HUMAN SKULL, pale scarred Orc face, heavy black plates and dirty red cloth. Compact Orc rider has large enough head, natural thighs straddling warg saddle, boots visible on flanks. Holds long curved battle scythe in right hand upright, left holds reins. Warg is hyena-like broad head and hunched shoulders, dark shaggy mane, angular muzzle, four correct legs, body oblique slightly left, alert crouched STANDING stance instead of running. Same high frontal 3/4 camera, no horse, no floating rider.

Ufthak, a game-original strong Orc warrior: bald olive-gray square face, broken nose and protruding lower lip, massive shoulders and very short neck, rough rusty scale cuirass and brown straps. Heavy hunched defensive stance, right foot sideways braced, thick cleaver held horizontally with both hands across waist. Stocky solid body, short compact shins and large forearms, approximately five heads. No helmet, no twin daggers.

An old Orc Sergeant with lean scarred olive face, drooping one ear and sparse gray hair, dented iron half-helmet and medium leather/iron armour, faded red rank sash. Lean-forward command stance, LEFT arm extended with open hand pointing forward, RIGHT hand holding broad curved blade diagonally behind shoulder ready to advance. Narrower waist than captain, feet braced across same ground line, no whip or marching clone.

An Orc Warg Rider, lean olive-skinned rider in patchy brown leather, low battered iron helmet and small round shield on left, sword raised outward right. Full hyena-like dark gray WARG with broad snarling head and a thick shaggy shoulder mane, short coarse fur and long rear body, four correct legs in low loping step, chest faces slightly right of frontal. Rider bends forward from hips in saddle, both thighs visible and boots either side, believable orc seated head-to-pelvis anatomy, not tiny rider. Same high-front 3/4 camera, not strict bird's eye.

A huge unarmoured Mordor Mountain Troll with very broad pale gray stone-like tough skin, bulbous bald domed head, long muscular arms and short bowed legs, roughly four-head monster anatomy. Bare body with battered leather loincloth and arm straps, one hand gripping a rough wooden club lowered to side, other heavy fist held across belly. Both feet planted widely, knees bent, hulking forward loom. Recognizable LOTR troll, not rock golem with boulder plates, not human in armour. Same fixed high FRONT 3/4 pixel style as reference.

A massive Mordor WAR TROLL in heavy blackened IRON PLATE and chainmail, broad squat gray troll face visible in a low brutal helmet, leathery pale-gray skin and elephantine feet. Wide shield-braced stance with massive broad rectangular shield forward left and huge spiked iron warhammer held horizontal in right hand just above waist, one bent knee. Thick big belly and long massive arms, compact four-head troll anatomy, not simply enlarged orc. GW LOTR armoured Mordor Troll, strong top-left pixel lighting.

An Olog-hai elite black-gate troll, broader shoulder and slightly more upright than common troll, leathery charcoal-gray skin, ugly flat troll face within barred iron helm. Layered iron scale cuirass, mail apron and articulated arm plates, skull belt, wide planted feet. BOTH hands grip a giant dark iron polehammer with rectangular hammer head raised diagonally across chest ready to strike; long arms massive forearms, stout four-head body. No shield, no copied war-troll stance, no neon fantasy surfaces.

A massive hulking TROLL shaman, gray-blue leathery skin, small bald knobby head, huge belly and long muscular arms, four-head troll proportions. Fur and bone mantle, ragged charcoal hide robes, large bone amulets, no metal plate knight armour. Crooked wooden staff with small skull and hanging charms in right hand; left palm held open forward as if chanting; low wide braced stance, head tilted slightly upward. Tiny dull blue runic beads only, no giant magic cloud. Same high FRONT 3/4 camera and crisp pixel-art shading.

Shelob: ONE enormous repulsive realistic LOTR spider monster with a BULBOUS hairy dark brown-gray abdomen, smaller cephalothorax, EIGHT individually articulated legs (FOUR EACH SIDE), two short pedipalps and large curved fangs. Red-brown tiny clustered eyes, no humanoid face, no armour. Body slightly diagonal but oriented toward viewer, front two legs raised and bent while other six spread on ground, abdomen higher behind. High FRONT 3/4 down angle 25 degrees matches other sprites, NOT top-down. All eight legs separated readable full silhouettes, genuine transparent background, no web scenery or base. Compact detailed pixel clusters matching Theoden.

A savage LOTR game-original Werewolf with a shaggy dark brown-gray wolf head, long muzzle and small pointed ears, massively muscled hunched torso, elongated forearms ending in clawed hands, digitigrade hindlegs. FOUR LIMBS TOTAL, NOT quadrupedal ordinary wolf. Low aggressive half-upright lunge with left claw reaching forward and right arm pulled back, heavy shoulders, short hunched neck and rough tan-brown mane. No clothing, no armour, no fire. Fixed high FRONT 3/4 view and detailed pixel sprite.

Sauron in WOLF FORM, one enormous sinister BLACK wolf with long lupine muzzle, pointed ears, thick black mane, ember-orange eyes and subtle red ember seams in shaggy dark fur. FOUR anatomically correct canine legs in a tense standing prowl, head lowered and angled slightly toward viewer left; broad shoulder hump, long tail curving close behind body. NO human limbs, NO upright werewolf, NO giant flame cloud obscuring silhouette. A few restrained warm embers only. Same high FRONT 3/4 camera, pixel clusters and contour as Theoden reference.

The Great Beast of Gorgoroth: one gigantic broad RHINOCEROS-LIKE Mordor siege beast with thick gray leathery wrinkled hide, heavy low horned head and FOUR short massive legs, NOT elephant or boar. A large WOODEN HOWDAH platform securely strapped on its back holding THREE clearly visible tiny Orc archers, wooden railing and rope harness, spikes on harness only. Lumbering grounded stance with one front leg slightly lifted, body turned slightly left from frontal, head lowered. Orc archers drawn compact at sensible scale. Whole beast and howdah visible, no crop. Fixed high FRONT 3/4 view 25 degrees, detailed pixel-art game sprite matching reference.

Sauron Dark Lord in his iconic LAST ALLIANCE form: towering broad armoured figure with blackened silver layered scale plate and angular gauntlets, tall distinctive razor-spired helmet with empty dark face slit, long shredded black cape with muted dark red inner edges. Actual torso/head anatomy compact approximately five heads without counting tall helmet spires. RIGHT hand grips massive many-flanged iron MACE lowered diagonally beside body, LEFT arm reaches forward with ONE GOLD RING visible on hand. Broad planted feet and chest upright imposing, NO shield, NO sword, no neon red circuitry or excessive glow. Same high FRONT 3/4 camera and restrained pixel palette.

Annatar Lord of Gifts: beautiful fair-skinned male elf-like humanoid, slender graceful FIVE-head compact body, long pale-gold hair, elegant ivory robes with restrained warm gold filigree and mantle, no armour or crown of Sauron. Stands calmly with both feet close and one knee relaxed, LEFT palm opened offering a SMALL golden ring, RIGHT hand holds a slender elegant gold staff vertical. Face visible and subtle knowing smile, no hood hiding eyes. Contrasts with massive Orcs by slender shoulders and fine waist, but head size consistent with standard bodies. Same high FRONT 3/4 downward angle, detailed crisp pixel-art.
